title: The harbour, walkable
caption: The sixth south-half district from island-half-1: the office street goes on west past Amakawa Trading into the harbour. The supply yard with its warehouse, containers, crane and the foreman's hut; the supply pier with a freighter alongside; the ferry landing with the terminal and a ferry alongside its pier; the harbour office; and the harbour walk south along the rocks. Reach it in the morning from the office street: walk west past Amakawa Trading. It also loads with ?place=harbour. The terminal and the harbour office are shut for now. The ships don't move.

sections.title: The office street's west end
sections.caption: Before: the street stopped at a row of bollards in front of Amakawa Trading. After: the bollards are gone and the street goes on west to the harbour. The finger sign now points west to the harbour too (Harbour 港).

sections.title: The supply yard
sections.caption: Before: open sea with a grey box standing in it (the island's coast stopped short of the harbour). After: a concrete yard on quays, containers in two blocks, a green footway painted across it to the landing, and the warehouse with にあげば SUPPLY QUAY over its roller doors.

sections.title: The ferry landing and pier
sections.caption: Before: open sea. After: the landing in pale granite with benches over the water, the terminal's door with フェリーのりば FERRY TERMINAL on its canopy (shut, 準備中), and the ferry moored along the pier with a gangway down to it.

sections.title: The harbour walk
sections.caption: Before: bare lawn. After: the coast walk carried north to the office street, with a bay of two benches looking west over the rocks, lamps and trees. It ends at bollards where the coast walk goes on south to the station (not walkable yet).

sections.title: After work
sections.caption: The lamps, the terminal's front, the floodlights and the ships' windows lit.
